competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, the claim may conflate standard and special items, or the 30-day window may be measured from purchase rather than delivery.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy for standard items allows a full refund if the item is returned within 30 days of delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: Evidence shows the current standard-item full-refund window is not 30 days, or that standard items are excluded from full refunds.
